summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title) with a docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning is_terminal-gated bool with a Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and Black were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
